sources.title: D-terms from generalized NS-NS fluxes in type II

evidence.text: How do generalized NS-NS fluxes enter four-dimensional N=1 type-II orientifold theories, and which fluxes charge R-R axions and generate D-term scalar potentials? The motivation is a richer potential for moduli stabilization and possible de Sitter or inflationary applications.

sources.title: Asymptotic Flux Compactifications and the Swampland

evidence.text: How does primitive internal four-form flux generate a complex-structure potential? The M/F-theory expression combines a moduli-dependent Hodge norm with a topological flux pairing constrained by the curvature tadpole.

sources.title: The web of swampland conjectures and the TCC bound

evidence.text: How should external four-form flux components enter a four-dimensional scalar potential obtained from a type-II compactification?

sources.title: Metastable vacua from torsion and machine learning

evidence.text: What classical ten-dimensional ingredients generate the proposed four-dimensional vacuum potential? The starting source set contains three-form fluxes, D3-branes and O3− planes, while the torsional five-form and wrapped D5 ingredients are introduced subsequently.

sources.title: Open strings in IIB orientifold reductions

evidence.text: How can dynamical open strings, non-Abelian brane gauge groups and internal Yang–Mills flux be incorporated into the dictionary between type IIB orientifold compactifications and six-dimensional N=(1,1) gauged supergravity?

sources.title: The Effective action of N = 1 Calabi-Yau orientifolds

evidence.text: Determine the four-dimensional N=1 bulk effective action of type IIB Calabi–Yau orientifolds with background fluxes, including Kähler potential, superpotential, gauge kinetic functions, and chiral versus linear multiplet descriptions.

sources.title: D-terms from generalized NS-NS fluxes in type II

evidence.text: The proposed R-R gauge transformation C_RR→C_RR+𝒟Λ identifies axion shifts and electric/magnetic charges. D-terms follow from D_A=i(∂_I K)δ_Aφⁱ for gauge-neutral W. In IIB the common superpotential expression is W=∫(F3+𝒟Φev_c)∧Ω.

sources.title: Asymptotic Flux Compactifications and the Swampland

evidence.text: Evaluate the intersection matrix on the full flux and on a selected light direction. Distinguish varying one fixed combination from independently varying every light coefficient; cancellation can satisfy the first condition without satisfying the second.

sources.title: The web of swampland conjectures and the TCC bound

evidence.text: Match each sector with its Hodge-dual complement, retain metric-dependent weights, and combine equal norm contributions. In the radius split, exchange zero-leg and one-leg sectors.

sources.title: Metastable vacua from torsion and machine learning

evidence.text: Insert a compactification metric, integrate the internal action and rescale the external metric before expressing each contribution in universal moduli. Here the printed Weyl factor fails the constant-background Einstein-Hilbert test, leaving the ten-dimensional derivation unresolved.

sources.title: Open strings in IIB orientifold reductions

evidence.text: Reduce the bulk action using Maurer–Cartan forms and include expanded non-Abelian Dirac–Born–Infeld and Wess–Zumino source actions. Couplings to dual RR potentials determine open-string corrections to bulk field strengths, which then enter the reduced potential.

sources.title: The Effective action of N = 1 Calabi-Yau orientifolds

evidence.text: Superspace and component chiral–linear duality derive the otherwise implicit Kähler coordinates. Cubic homogeneity in the linear variables exposes the no-scale cancellation, while differentiation of implicit coordinate relations determines the metric.

sources.title: Topological mirror symmetry with fluxes

evidence.text: What intrinsic topology carries the integer NS flux under mirror symmetry, and which additional geometric data and nonharmonic forms are needed for effective theories on SU(3)-structure manifolds?

sources.title: Taxonomy of scalar potential with <math display="inline"><mi>U</mi></math>-dual fluxes

evidence.text: How can the large four-dimensional scalar potential induced by U-dual-completed type IIB fluxes be reorganized to expose its flux-bilinear structure, constraints and possible higher-dimensional origins?

sources.title: N=1 effective potential from dual type-IIA D6/O6 orientifolds with general fluxes

evidence.text: How do general fluxes and D6/O6 sources determine the four-dimensional N=1 potential directly from ten-dimensional type IIA, and which consistency conditions and supersymmetric moduli-stabilizing vacua extend beyond truncated N=4 gaugings?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures for type IIB orientifolds with closed-string U(1)s

evidence.text: Which moduli and gauge fields survive an O3/O7 orientifold? Complex-structure deformations and closed-string U(1)s occupy different N=1 multiplets after the parent vector sector splits.

sources.title: The Type IIA Flux Potential, 4-forms and Freed-Witten anomalies

evidence.text: How can the classical type IIA flux F-term potential, including D6-brane moduli and localised sources, be organised through four-forms, axion polynomials and microscopic anomaly cancellation?

sources.title: KK-monopoles and G-structures in M-theory/type IIA reductions

evidence.text: Can metric fluxes and moduli in M-theory/massive IIA STU models be represented by intrinsic torsion, permitting higher-dimensional uplifts even when the Jacobi constraints required for ordinary twisted-torus reductions are relaxed?

sources.title: Nongeometric flux compactifications

evidence.text: Construct a T-duality-complete flux superpotential and flux constraints for a simple type II toroidal orientifold, including nongeometric Q- and R-fluxes, and clarify which structures admit local or global geometric interpretations.

sources.title: From ten to four and back again: How to generalize the geometry

evidence.text: How is a generalized flux compactification projected to the desired N=1 field content? The orientifold combines a world-sheet operation with an internal involution, with spinorial consistency determining whether a left-moving fermion-parity factor is needed.

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Which generalized NS-NS flux configurations admit consistent four-dimensional IIA orientifold descriptions and useful moduli potentials?

sources.title: Gauged supergravities and non-geometric Q/R-fluxes from asymmetric orbifold CFT`s

evidence.text: How can exact freely acting orbifold CFTs determine the flux algebra of effective gauged supergravity and realize Q/R backgrounds, including simultaneous fluxes and examples without geometric T-duals?

sources.title: Massive IIA flux compactifications with dynamical open strings

evidence.text: How do dynamical D6-brane positions, Wilson lines and non-Abelian gauge data modify massive IIA flux compactifications, their four-dimensional scalar potential, AdS vacua and perturbative reliability?

sources.title: Gaugings at angles from orientifold reductions

evidence.text: What higher-dimensional orientifold mechanism produces relative electromagnetic SL(2) angles between gauge factors in four-dimensional N=4 supergravity, and how do bulk fluxes and local source terms cooperate in moduli stabilization?

sources.title: The Effective action of type II Calabi-Yau orientifolds

evidence.text: What geometric data determine the four-dimensional N=1 bulk effective actions of type II Calabi-Yau orientifolds, including flux potentials, chiral coordinates, dual linear multiplets and higher-dimensional embeddings?

sources.title: Exceptional Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: How can source-free type II flux backgrounds be embedded into maximal four-dimensional gauged supergravity so that their critical points, full scalar spectra, supersymmetry and gauge groups can be determined?

sources.title: Romans type IIA theory and the heterotic strings

evidence.text: Can RR flux in a two-torus reduction restore duality covariance of massive type IIA supergravity and provide a route from Romans backgrounds to heterotic backgrounds despite their different massive tensor and vector descriptions?

sources.title: 6D (1,1) Gauged Supergravities from Orientifold Compactifications

evidence.text: Which orientifold reductions of type II/M-theory yield nonchiral N=(1,1) gauged supergravity in six dimensions, how do their fluxes map to embedding tensors, and which maximally symmetric extrema occur in the resulting restricted flux sectors?

sources.title: Generalized N=1 orientifold compactifications and the Hitchin functionals

evidence.text: Determine the bulk four-dimensional N=1 spectrum, Kähler potentials and flux/torsion superpotentials of generalized type II orientifolds, and test candidate mirrors of Calabi–Yau orientifolds with restricted electric and magnetic NS–NS flux.

sources.title: The Effective action of type IIA Calabi-Yau orientifolds

evidence.text: What are the bulk chiral coordinates, Kähler potential, gauge kinetic functions and flux superpotential of generic type IIA Calabi–Yau orientifolds, and how do their effective actions connect to special G2 compactifications and orientifold mirror symmetry?

sources.title: Hitchin functionals in N=2 supergravity

evidence.text: How can type II supergravity on backgrounds admitting eight selected supercharges be organized in an N=2-like form, and how do intrinsic torsion and fluxes determine its geometry, prepotentials and possible four-dimensional truncations?

sources.title: Open string multi-branched and Kähler potentials

evidence.text: How do D-brane position and Wilson-line modes enter the flux-generated F-term potential together with closed-string moduli, and what do its discrete symmetries imply for holomorphic coordinates and the Kähler potential?

sources.title: Minkowski 3-forms, Flux String Vacua, Axion Stability and Naturalness

evidence.text: How do Minkowski three-forms encode internal fluxes, moduli auxiliary fields and axion potentials in Type II orientifolds, and can their gauge and duality symmetries constrain corrections sufficiently to stabilize large-field potentials or interacting scalar masses?

sources.title: Mirror symmetry in generalized Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: What compactification geometry supplies the missing mirror partners of electric NS three-form flux, and can its type IIA low-energy action match type IIB on a Calabi–Yau threefold?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Which combinations of H, metric, Q, and R flux admit consistent four-dimensional N=1 IIA orientifold descriptions, how do they generate D-terms and stabilize moduli, and which admit ten-dimensional constructions with correct flux quantization?

sources.title: Lectures on Nongeometric Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Which fields survive in a tractable orientifold model used to compare geometric and nongeometric flux potentials? The construction identifies the N=4 spectrum, considers flux breaking to N=1, and then restricts to three identical two-tori.

sources.title: Some remarks on Swampland conjectures, fluxes and K-theory in IIB toroidal compactifications

evidence.text: How do three-form fluxes, nonperturbative superpotential terms, and non-BPS tension compete in the U,S,T sector of an isotropic IIB orientifold?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Which flux and localized-source combinations define consistent compactifications and effective theories when geometrical flux changes the internal topology? The paper studies this question classically, principally for type-IIA orientifolds with four-dimensional supersymmetry.

sources.title: Flux moduli stabilisation, Supergravity algebras and no-go theorems

evidence.text: Which flux-induced supergravity algebras are compatible with the isotropic T⁶/(Z₂×Z₂) orientifolds, and which resulting effective models can evade necessary no-go conditions for nonsupersymmetric Minkowski or de Sitter vacua with stabilized moduli?

sources.title: Type IIB on $S^{3}\times S^{3}$ through $Q$ & $P$ fluxes

evidence.text: Can particular STU superpotentials interpreted as non-geometric Q/P flux on a torus instead arise from geometric, non-toroidal type-IIB backgrounds, thereby breaking no-scale behavior without nonperturbative effects?

sources.title: Geometric non-geometry

evidence.text: Which STU models containing fluxes classified as non-geometric in a toroidal description can instead arise from geometric M-theory reductions on spaces with different topologies?

sources.title: $\beta$-supergravity: a ten-dimensional theory with non-geometric fluxes, and its geometric framework

evidence.text: Can a ten-dimensional NSNS reformulation identify non-geometric Q- and R-fluxes, explain their geometric structures, and provide an origin for some four-dimensional gauged supergravities?

sources.title: Progress in D-brane model building

evidence.text: How can D-branes produce weakly coupled four-dimensional N=1 type II orientifold vacua with semi-realistic gauge sectors, and how do background fluxes change the allowed branes, effective couplings, moduli stabilization and supersymmetry breaking?
